[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Margaret was born in 1688. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1090|George Glasgow]] and [[Smith-230891|Fanne Smith]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1090]] is assessed at 54% (possible). Margaret's 23 September 1688 Kilwinning transcript names George Glasgow and Anne Smith; Scotland's People gives Fanne Smith. A father born in 1627 could still have a child in 1688, and the family account places the selected George with the Smith household. The roughly sixty-one-year paternal age and Glasgow-to-Kilwinning identification need corroboration.

Possible full-profile placement. The record father George is named; Anne/Fanne and9/23 September are source variants, not resolved vital or maternal facts.

Next useful test: Find the George/Smith marriage or an earlier family entry identifying his age or origin.

Source basis already held: [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F3624976&tab=this Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564-1929: Margaret Glasgow, 23 Sep 1688, record SCOT/OPR/BAP/3624976]; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ Scotland’s People, Old Parish Registers, births and baptisms (https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/), exact surname Glasgow through 1700, index text supplied 10 September 2026: MARGARET GLASGOW, 23/09/1688, GEORGE GLASGOW/FANNE SMITH FR72 (FR72), indexed gender F, Kilwinning, parish 599, reference 10 / 60.
